shorts.title: Brain Parasites Make These Fish Dance for Herons
shorts.hook: Meet the California killifish. Its brain parasites have a plan.
shorts.outro: The fish was the easy part. Then Doug went in. The full list is linked below.
shorts.description: A fluke packs thousands of cysts into a killifish's brain, and the infected fish start dancing at the surface for the birds that eat them.

shorts.title: A Spot Crawled Across This Man's Brain for Four Years
shorts.outro: Where it came from is even stranger. The full story is linked below.
shorts.description: Scans showed a ring-shaped spot that moved at least five centimeters across one man's brain over four years, and it was not a tumor.

shorts.title: This Brain Infection Lives in Ordinary Garden Soil
shorts.outro: That was the last one. Eight brain parasites got there first. The full list is linked below.
shorts.description: A brain-infecting amoeba that kills nine out of ten people it infects lives in ordinary dirt, and Doug has a small scratch on his hand.
